n77f51d5149.headline: Official dollar rate for the weekend fell below 60 rubles
n77f51d5149.summary: The Bank of Russia set the official dollar rate for June 24-25 at 59.66 rubles, down 49 kopecks, while the euro rate fell to 66.68 rubles.
n77f51d5149.why: Currency exchange rates set by central banks influence trade, inflation, and capital flows in Russia's economy.
n77f51d5149.why_moved: The official rate adjustment reflects central bank policy and market conditions affecting the ruble's value.

na88dff5e75.headline: Algeria's Foreign Exchange Reserves Are Currently 114 Billion Dollars, According to Tebboune
na88dff5e75.summary: Prime Minister Abdelmadjid Tebboune stated Algeria's foreign exchange reserves currently stand at $114 billion.
na88dff5e75.why: Foreign exchange reserves are crucial for Algeria's economic stability, currency support, and ability to manage external shocks in an oil-dependent economy.
